# P001: unexpected token

**Severity:** error · **Stage:** parser

The parser found a token that the grammar does not allow at this point. The message names what was expected. Statements end at a line break, so a statement split across lines also reports P001 with "found end of line".

## Failing example

```saxl
system Shop
service
```

## Fixed example

```saxl
system Shop
service Web
```
